hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$({ npm run -s lint && npm run -s prettier:ci; } 2>&1) || { printf 'Push blocked: lint or prettier check failed.\n%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -40)" >&2; exit 2; }
hooks.statusMessage: Running lint and prettier check before push
